Where these numbers come from

  • Source: California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC), daily data export (ABC licensing reports), file header "Updated Monday 2nd of November 2026 02:50:23 AM". ABC's Conditions of Use: its information "is considered in the public domain". Counts are Westworks's tally of that file.
  • Counted: applications (not issued licenses) with ABC status PEND, for fixed-premises on-sale license types (restaurants, bars, hotels, clubs, brewpubs and similar). One per ABC file number, placed by premises county.
  • History: Our daily archive of ABC's file has 3 snapshots, from October 31, 2026 to November 2, 2026 (2 days). ABC's file has no filing date, so "new" means a file number that wasn't in an earlier snapshot. Applications already pending on October 31, 2026 count as pending, not new.
  • "On file at least 30 days": ABC numbers its files in sequence. ABC's own record for file 683100 shows status date September 30, 2026 (read November 2, 2026), so every pending file numbered 683,100 or lower was filed on or before that date. Newer files are left off this page; they go to subscribers.
  • Names: only business names (DBA or company) are shown, and only where the licensee is clearly a company. Owners who may be individuals are never stored or shown. Names that suggest a hospital, clinic, senior-living facility, school or children's facility are screened out before storage.
  • Applications, not openings. Some are new restaurants, some are new owners of existing ones, and some will be withdrawn or denied. Each ABC number links to ABC's own record.
